summary: The first command used a nonexistent project-root remote .venv and stopped before GPU or experiment creation.
evidence: SSH returned .venv/bin/python: No such file or directory before the audited launcher ran.
lessons: Use system Python only for the lightweight wrapper; the wrapper must launch training through the pinned BWM environment.
limitations: No immutable run directory or training output was created.
next_actions: Rerun the wrapper with system Python and retain BWM .venv for the actual model process.
